substantive_checks.qualifiers_and_policy_status: pass; the unsupported exact whole-axis length was replaced by explicit conceptual/full-axis wording while the registered 1.0 km CORRIDOR-04 pilot remains unchanged
substantive_checks.site_overview_semantic_equivalence: pass; V6 Chinese and English overview figures are generated from the same submitted GeoJSON and v0.4 opportunity grid. The final map is horizontally unrolled with the cross-axis x2 disclosure, shows the provisional boundary, three key areas, 8+4 node classes, CORRIDOR-04 and 37 robust cells, and moves full labels to a sidebar to remove central label collisions.
substantive_checks.public_space_ratio_dashboard: pass; visual/index.html and visual/index.en.html render public_space_ratio=0.000336464 as 0.0336%, label it as the V2 twelve-service-node module footprint over the working base, and explicitly state that it is neither site-wide public-space provision nor a planning-control metric; targeted headless-Chrome screenshots verify the rendered value and qualifiers in both languages
substantive_checks.translation_residue: pass for final English figure set; all 18 .en.png figures were resized and OCR-scanned with chi_sim+eng and returned zero 2+ CJK sequences. V6 English SVG generation additionally hard-fails on any CJK codepoint, preventing reviewer-reported Chinese-unit residues. Final PDF screenshots retain the English 192.6k expression.
substantive_checks.rendering: pass at deterministic screenshot-QA level; all 18 Chinese + 18 English A3 pages and 4 Chinese + 4 English A0 boards (44 pages total) were rendered to individual PNG screenshots. qa_drawings_v2 reports all_pass=true and bilingual_page_count_match=true with no blank pages, text-block bounds errors, or outer-edge clipping flags. OCR of final English screenshot appearances recognizes the V6 spatial/metric titles and core values. Local Codex image-model visual calls were attempted but exceeded the connector single-call limit, so this record does not claim a separate model-human visual pass.
